regulators.name: Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council
regulators.notes: Registers medical and dental practitioners. Verify registration status directly with council.

regulators.name: Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council
regulators.notes: Registers nurses and midwives. Verify registration and any practice restrictions.

regulators.name: National Drug Authority
regulators.notes: Regulates pharmacy practice and drug distribution. Verify pharmacist and pharmacy technician registration.

regulators.name: Uganda Allied Health Professionals Council
regulators.notes: Registers allied health professionals including laboratory, imaging, rehabilitation, nutrition.

regulators.name: Uganda Medical Laboratory Practitioners Council
regulators.notes: Registers medical laboratory practitioners. Verify laboratory scientist and technician registration.

regulators.name: Uganda Counselling and Psychotherapy Council
regulators.notes: Registers counsellors and psychotherapists. Verify registration status.

regulators.name: Uganda National Bureau of Standards
regulators.notes: Not a clinical regulator. May be relevant for facility equipment and product standards.

regulators.name: Ministry of Health Uganda
regulators.notes: Sets national health policy, standards and guidelines. Not a registration body but relevant for facility licensing and compliance.

regulators.name: No statutory regulator recorded
regulators.notes: Used for non-clinical, support and administrative roles where no statutory registration applies.
